title: Phase Transitions and Chaos Bound in Horava Lifshitz Black Holes using Lyapunov Exponents
summary: We probe the thermodynamic phase structure of four dimensional Horava Lifshitz black holes by Lyapunov exponent analysis. For both massless and massive test particles, the Lyapunov exponent exhibits a multivalued dependence on temperature in regimes with a first-order phase transition, with distinct branches corresponding to small, intermediate, and large black hole phases, and this behaviour disappears at the critical point.
